title: AI-Powered Data Analysis Platform
objective: Build a cloud platform for data analysis, interactive charts, and automated reporting — reducing manual analyst work.
solution: Built an in-memory SaaS tool with real-time processing, natural language querying via Gemini AI, interactive chart generation, and automated PDF report export. Built with Next.js, Python, and Redis.
impact: Allowed non-technical users to run data analysis through conversational AI, cutting the time from question to answer from hours to minutes.

title: Podcast AI-ETL Pipeline
objective: Automate the processing of large video files, converting hours of footage into searchable, timestamped text using local and cloud AI.
solution: Built a Python application using open-source speech-to-text models for transcription, with NLP post-processing for speaker identification and topic segmentation.
impact: Cut manual video processing time by over 80%, making content searchable and indexed.

title: Real-Time Country Dashboard
objective: Bring together scattered data across sectors — economy, health, weather — into one real-time dashboard for decision-makers in Yemen.
solution: Built automated ETL pipelines to pull data from multiple APIs and public sources, with interactive Power BI dashboards including drill-down views and row-level security for different stakeholders.
impact: Replaced scattered data sources with a single dashboard, helping programme leadership make faster, evidence-based decisions.

title: Enterprise Database Architecture
objective: Move TNSC from unorganized spreadsheets to a structured relational database for daily business operations.
solution: Designed a normalized database schema with proper entity relationships, data integrity rules, and migration scripts. Replaced ad-hoc Excel workflows with SQL-based data access and reporting.
impact: Gave the business one reliable place for its data, improved data accuracy, and made automated reporting possible.
